20663.title: Dead Reckoning
20663.overview: War heroes Rip Murdock  and Johnny Drake are sent to Washington, D.C, to receive top honors for their service. Johnny, seemingly terrified by the publicity that awaits him, jumps off the train and later turns up dead. Suspecting foul play, Rip begins digging into his pal's past. He encounters cover-ups, threats to his own life and deadly femme fatale Coral Chandler.

46647.title: Bog of Beasts
46647.overview: A man falls in love with a teenage girl, who is exploited by her own grandfather, who sometimes takes her to a gas station to show her naked to whomever pays him some money.

396535.title: Train to Busan
396535.overview: When a zombie virus pushes Korea into a state of emergency, those trapped on an express train to Busan must fight for their own survival.

517815.title: The Girl and the Spider
517815.overview: Lisa is moving. Upheaval all around: Her mother flirts with a handyman. An eccentric woman seems to be preparing for a glamorous event, a family next door returns from vacation, and a girl documents the adventurous day. As boxes are transported, walls painted white, and furniture is assembled, underlying problems in need of fixing are revealed, a to-do list expands, and desires and needs flair up.
517815.trailerName: The Girl and the Spider - Official Trailer

673591.title: Gina
673591.overview: After spending three years in jail, Juan goes free with the aim of recovering Eva's love. Zoe and Ismael, two ex-partners who he betrayed, will return to cross in his way.

691703.title: Finding Uranus
691703.overview: A young "incel" man embarks on a futuristic jerk-off session.

1007415.title: Odium for Ardor
1007415.overview: An author suffering from a sophomore slump hides in a motel room and faces his demons.

1073591.title: Kaïros
1073591.overview: After a year of filming abroad, Manu, a once prominent actor, returns to his hometown. But getting back into the business isn't as easy as he thought. After several unsuccessful auditions, he's no longer sure of anything. Against all odds, he lands a job hosting a nighttime call-in radio show. His listeners are mainly newcomers, refugees and exiles with varied life experiences, working graveyard shifts. Manu gradually appropriates this space, this gathering of mixed voices, to launch philosophical questions into the night. His words are engaging. He becomes an anchor for many listeners. His life takes on new meaning.
1073591.trailerName: Kairos | Bande-annonce officelle | Au cinéma dès le 15 mai 2026

1079927.title: Vedaat Marathe Veer Daudale Saat
1079927.overview: It shows the inspirational story of the extraordinary bravery of seven Maratha warriors of Maratha Empire to achieve dream of Swaraj in 1674.

1130679.title: Kamu Harus Mati
1130679.overview: Meta has been haunted by hallucinations since the death of her boyfriend. She feels terrorized by spirits, but her two best friends assume she's mentally ill, straining their relationship. As the terror intensifies and threatens her friends as well, Meta sets out to uncover the truth behind the events, even as she faces doubts about whether they're real or just hallucinations.
1130679.trailerName: Pamela Bowie Trapped in a Deadly Illusion! You Must Die Official Trailer

1137207.title: Wild Heart
1137207.overview: Moving from the city to the countryside, 11-year-old Anni has a tough time settling in – until she encounters Wild Heart, an untamed horse, to whom she feels an almost magical connection. But soon after, their bond is put at risk, as some ruthless horse thieves are targeting Wild Heart’s herd.

1155767.title: Thi Baan The Series 3
1155767.overview: The sequel to the 2018 film. Plot TBA.
1155767.original_title: ไทบ้าน เดอะซีรีส์ 3

1172343.title: God Is Still Brazilian
1172343.overview: God needs to return to Earth when celestial beings rebel against humanity and decide to launch another meteor to exterminate life on the planet.

1253175.title: Prince: Once Upon a Time in Dhaka

1253751.title: Sanding Dreams
1253751.overview: Pasha, 19, studies in St. Petersburg and dreams of designing space rockets. He comes from the village of Shoyna, where his family remains - mother, father and younger brother. One day, Pasha receives a telegram about his father's death and returns home to take care of his family. Soon he learns that he has won an international grant, but a rocket launched from the cosmodrome falls on their house and injures his mother. To help her, Pasha decides to move the house to a higher ground where there is no sand and the sea is visible.

1268919.title: The Botanist
1268919.overview: In a remote village in Xinjiang, a young Kazakh boy named Arsin, who finds solace in the company of plants. He soon meets Meiyu, a spirited Han girl whose unpredictable nature reminds him of a rare, otherworldly plant. As their friendship blossoms, it deepens into a delicate, dreamlike allegory that blurs the lines between reality and the enchanting world of botany.

1275255.title: Angels of War
1275255.overview: In November, at the very beginning of the terrible winter of 1941, when the blockade ring closes around Leningrad, a group of young iceboat athletes goes out onto the thin, not yet formed ice. The mission to deliver ammunition turns into an operation to save orphans from an orphanage who were not evacuated in time. Former rivals in regatta sports must now turn into a real united team in order to survive themselves and give hope to everyone else.

1277047.title: The Boy at the Edge of the World
1277047.overview: Omul lives with his family on a remote island in the Fire Archipelago. During a beach trip, a storm sweeps Omul and his younger sister Kimi into the sea, where Omul witnesses a mysterious creature threatening Kimi’s soul.  Rescued by a whale, the siblings survive, but Kimi is left in a coma. Omul’s ability to talk to animals becomes crucial as he and his brother – who blames him for the accident – set out to find Sadumea, the mythical figure behind Kimi’s torment.  With their dog Tela, they embark on a dangerous expedition deep into the island to save Kimi…

1285815.title: Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha – Shri Ram Ki
1285815.original_title: Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha – Shri Ram Ki

1339767.title: Czech Girl
1339767.overview: Widowed Zdena lives a quiet life as a postwoman in a small Czech village. When her beloved son Lukas returns home from France to say goodbye to his dying grandmother, his determination to make her seemingly impossible wish come true leads him to reveal a secret that challenges the values of the village: his queer life in Paris and his drag queen alter ego, Chica Checa.

1356215.title: Backwoods
1356215.overview: Marta decides to take her daughters, Agáta and Mína, leave her toxic husband, and start over. She finds refuge in the house of her father, an eccentric loner who has spent his entire life preparing for the end of the world.  Their time together reveals long-suppressed family conflicts, many of them triggered by the husband. When Milan accuses Marta of kidnapping the children, the father drives him away, strengthening the bond with his daughter.

1376439.title: Jean Valjean
1376439.overview: Jean Valjean is released from prison after nineteen years of hard labor, violence, and suffering. Filled with anger and a deep sense of injustice, he has become a dangerous man who trusts no one and nothing. When he arrives in a small village in Provence, he is repeatedly turned away. Desperate, he unknowingly finds refuge at the house of Bishop Bienvenu, who lives simply, with his sister and a single servant. There, he is surprised by their warm welcome, and his inner demons start to waver. But the temptation to be what society sees in him still haunts him, and he steals the Bishop’s silverware. When the police ultimately catches him, the Bishop forgives him and gifts him the candlesticks. This acts becomes the starting point of Jean Valjean’ transformation into a new man who reclaims his humanity.

1380279.title: The Plastic Men
1380279.overview: Vietnam veteran Jonathan Teller suffers from guilt and paranoid delusions. He decides to take his own life, but as he struggles to come to terms with his choice and reality, a chance encounter changes everything.
1380279.trailerName: The Plastic Men | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1383287.title: Ulysse
1383287.overview: Alice, a sociology researcher, and Volodymyr, a pianist, are going to have a child! They will call him Ulysses. Except that Ulysses, at one year old, doesn't fit the growth charts. Too small, too thin, and he still isn't walking. The verdict comes down: Ulysses won't be like the others. But how will he be?

1400119.title: Era Uma Vez Minha 1ª Vez
1400119.overview: The first time rarely goes the way we expect—especially when we expect too much. Teresa, Clara, Tuca, and Patty are in a hurry and make a pact: lose their virginity before high school prom night. They just forgot one tiny detail: everyone moves at their own pace.

1416055.title: Give It Up
1416055.overview: A privileged young man attempts to foray into the world of outrage comedy, but can't finish a set without getting brutalized.

1419383.title: Die andere Seite
1419383.overview: Since losing her family, a woman is living alone in the wilderness — far away from society, which is dominated by mistrust and fear after the outbreak of a fatal disease. When she is forced to leave this life behind, she not only experiences a boundless freedom, but also remembers the importance of human closeness and the feeling of belonging.

1424567.title: Bhanupriya Bhooter Hotel
1424567.overview: When ghosts come calling on guests at a hotel, all hell breaks loose.

1432631.title: Idhayam Murali
1432631.overview: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.
1432631.trailerName: Hrudhayam Murali - Official Trailer | Atharvaa | Fahadh Faasil | Preity | Thaman S | Aakash Baskaran

1442935.title: What Is The Right Way?
1442935.overview: A girl who has lost her beauty turns to a local saint for help. Waiting for a miracle, she stays in his house and becomes a hermit. An ancient icon becomes her confidant, prompting her to perform the true miracle herself.

1443959.title: Every Dog Has Its Day
1443959.overview: Old Lin, a retired steel mill veteran with mobility issues, lives a materially comfortable yet emotionally desolate life. His routine is unexpectedly disrupted when he crosses paths with Ma Teng, an idle drifter brimming with "useless knowledge" and a chronic habit of abandoning projects midway, during a botched caregiver interview. What begins as a comedic clash of misunderstandings evolves into an extraordinary companionship. Through their unlikely journey bridging generational and social divides, the mismatched pair transforms from chaotic strangers into mutual pillars of support. This transgenerational bond defying conventional boundaries of age and mortality becomes a profound testament to human resilience. In each other's flawed existence, they discover the courage to confront physical decline and mortality, ultimately unearthing the fortitude to embrace life's uncertainties with renewed bravery.

1444471.title: Sweet Milk Lake
1444471.overview: After being mistaken for his twin brother by his estranged and dying dad, a soft-spoken trans man relishes the opportunity to be one of the boys, until the weight of the lie becomes heavier than his need for the truth.

1461751.title: Black Men in Uniform
1461751.overview: Pata Seca  (1828), a man whose back bore the whip marks of his enslavers , whose eyes held the haunted memory of being forced to breed over 200 slave children in order to sustain his master’s plantation.  Men broken but unbowed, transformed from field hands into soldiers from the civil war to Vietnam.  This documentary weaves together authentic narratives from the 1800s, accompanied by original images and footage, highlighting the significant influence that Black men in uniform had in Hollywood and addressing ongoing relevant issues to date.
1461751.trailerName: Black Men In Uniform: The Untold Story Official Trailer

1465591.title: Billy Idol Should Be Dead
1465591.overview: Punk legend turned pop sensation Billy Idol bares it all in this electrifying documentary, revealing his rise to fame, battle with addiction and triumphant comeback that captivated millions of fans worldwide.

1465655.title: Natchez
1465655.overview: Filmmaker Suzannah Herbert takes a sharp look at the American South’s unreconciled history through a Mississippi town that mixes antebellum tourism with a community deeply divided over its past. With an unflinching lens, the film captures the debates, memories, and tensions that are building toward a reckoning.

1466423.title: The King of Horror
1466423.overview: A young director is obsessed with casting a long-lost coursemate in a horror film — the one who vanished after a disturbing incident they both swore to forget.

1468471.title: A Machu Picchu Proposal
1468471.overview: Katie agrees to join her brother Dan and his girlfriend Luciana on a trip to Peru. Dan plans to propose to Luciana in a grand way at Machu Picchu at the end of the week and needs Katie’s Spanish speaking skills to ask Luciana’s Peruvian father for his blessing. However, when Luciana’s friend, Chef Carlos, arrives, he accidentally ruins each proposal attempt. Refusing to give up, Katie does everything in her power to make this proposal happen, until Dan calls it off. Katie must lean into Chef Carlos’ spontaneity to not only save the day and the proposal, and Carlos may just win Katie’s heart too!

1472951.title: Infiltrate
1472951.overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

1480503.title: CoComelon: The Movie
1480503.overview: JJ embarks on the biggest adventure of his life: Kindergarten. But when, on his first day at school, JJ discovers that his beloved stuffed bear Boba has gone missing, JJ and his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina will begin a quest that will transport them into a magical land ruled by Princess Harmony, who has created a world with one rule: No singing.

1481975.title: Wonder Beast
1481975.overview: With fairy-tale inhabitants, everything is the same as with people - when a marriage breaks up, Resentment remains... That is the name of the daughter of the powerful magicians Bolotnitsa and Chernogor, who divorced but continue to share power over the child. On the day of Resentment's coming of age, it turns out that she is deprived of the magical power that was supposed to be inherited from her parents. To fix the situation, Resentment urgently needs to find a groom in the human world, have a wedding and sacrifice the person - turn him into a tree... Together with Resentment, her mysterious friend, Chudo Yudo, goes to the human world. He can transform into anyone: a bird, an animal, and even a handsome prince.

1483319.title: Shana
1483319.overview: Shana navigates the trials and tribulations of everyday life with boundless energy and the support of her group of friends. When her grandmother passes away, she inherits a ring that is supposed to protect her from bad luck. Shana certainly needs this helping hand. Especially since her toxic partner has been released from prison, and misfortunes are piling up…

1497463.title: All That We Never Were
1497463.overview: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

1498743.title: The Pension Heist
1498743.overview: The film PENSJONSKUPPET (The Pension Heist) tells the story of three women in their prime who are written off as "too old" by their employers, their spouses, and even the healthcare system. But this feisty trio refuses to take it lying down. Together, they hatch a cunning plan to pull off the ultimate score… robbing Norway’s very own Sovereign Wealth Fund – the famous Oil Fund.

1501239.title: Can't Cry with Your Face
1501239.overview: In their first year of high school, a girl named Mizumura and a boy named Sakahira fell into a swimming pool and mysteriously switched bodies. They live out each other's lives for 15 years, all through high school, college and beyond, and frequently exchange information about what's going on in their lives. Then, all of a sudden, Mizumura tells Sakahira that she might have found a way for them to switch back. But do they even want to do that at that point?

1502135.title: Hideaway: The Dossiers
1502135.overview: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.

1510583.title: Rakkhosh
1510583.overview: The story about a man pushed to his limits by love and greed, who eventually embraces his darker side to seek justice or revenge in a world filled with "monsters."

1510775.title: Gunmaaster G9
1510775.overview: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.
1510775.trailerName: Gunmaaster G9 Teaser | Emraan, Genelia, Aparshakti | Aditya Datt | Himesh R | Deepak M | 27 Nov 2026

1517111.title: Boorman and the Devil
1517111.overview: Featuring commentary from surviving participants, as well as other filmmakers and critics, this documentary chronicles the career of director John Boorman and the tumultuous production of his film Exorcist II: The Heretic, exploring its critical and commercial failure, how it changed the industry, and the importance of risk-taking in art.

1540151.title: Block 10
1540151.overview: In early 1943, at the Auschwitz main camp, hundreds of Jewish women are confined in cramped quarters in BLOCK 10, which is separated from the rest of the camp grounds. Nazi doctors subject them to the most painful methods of forced sterilization. Prisoner doctors are forced to collaborate. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

1546935.title: Salón de Belleza
1546935.overview: A beauty salon in a city ravaged by a mysterious disease becomes a refuge for the afflicted as they linger between life and death.

1553591.title: Shame and Money
1553591.overview: After losing their livelihood in a village, a Kosovar family is forced to move to the capital in pursuit of a place in a hypercapitalist society.

1554807.title: Hộ Linh Tráng Sĩ: Bí ẩn mộ Vua Đinh
1554807.overview: Based on the folklore about the 7 warriors and the mystery of the tomb of Emperor Dinh.
1554807.trailerName: HỘ LINH TRÁNG SĨ - BÍ ẨN MỘ VUA ĐINH | Teaser | Dự kiến khởi chiếu lễ 2/9/2026

1555895.title: The Aryan Papers
1555895.overview: Stuttgart, 1942: Nazis have cleared Jewish communities from towns and Villages. Two German-born Jewish children flee Nazis who have killed their family, escorted by Gisella, part of the Lebensborn, an SS Master Race program.

1562807.title: Rhapsody in Blue
1562807.overview: After years on the margins of a ballet company because of her skin color, a young Black dancer finally takes the lead role. As her body is exoticized for success, she must choose between pleasing and dancing in her truth.

1577911.title: Class Reunion 4: Friends for Life
1577911.overview: When Niels turns 50 and decides life is pointless, his two best friends drag him on a trip full of catfishing, denial, and the rediscovery that none of them are doing particularly well at adulthood.

1590903.title: My Own Last Supper
1590903.overview: 76-year-old widower Encek convenes his children for a final dinner, unveiling concealed memoirs of love, loss and generational wounds before choosing the sea as his reunion place with his deceased wife.
1590903.trailerName: My Own Last Supper ( Rencana Besar untuk Mati dengan Tenang ) | Official International Trailer

1592055.title: Guided by Horses
1592055.overview: In the stunning beauty of the Kimberley, this feature length documentary is a cinematic story of hope, rising from the quiet, unexpectedly powerful bond between a cast of young people and horses, who are participating in a uniquely special sanctuary created by Aboriginal researcher Professor Juli Coffin.

1594615.title: Lift
1594615.overview: Six years after an office elevator accident that claimed many lives, PT Jamsa Land is terrorized again. Linda, the company's public relations staff, is trapped in the elevator and forced to face a mysterious voice from the intercom. Her child is taken hostage, and Linda has no choice but to participate in a dangerous game that slowly reveals the dark secrets of the tragedy six years ago.
1594615.trailerName: LIFT | OFFICIAL TRAILER | 26 FEBRUARI 2026 DI BIOSKOP

1604151.title: Oliver West
1604151.overview: West Knight secretly helps Oliver, a ghost only she can see, cross over to the afterlife before his spiritual essence deteriorates completely. While her step sibling Jaime navigates a new romance with coworker Quinn, West discovers that Oliver's unfinished business isn't about supernatural rituals—it's about experiencing human connection and love.
1604151.trailerName: Oliver West | Official Trailer HD | FLF

1608055.title: Balas Budi
1608055.overview: Budi seems like the ideal man. However, when his cover is blown, the four women who were his victims decide not to remain silent. They transform into a professional team. With a secret headquarters full of strategies, they devise a master plan to teach Budi a lesson.
1608055.trailerName: Official Trailer RETURN TO BUDI 👀❤️ - Cinépolis Indonesia

1608247.title: Baapya
1608247.overview: In coastal Konkan, an ordinary family and their tight-knit town face change, identity, and buried emotions when an unexpected return from the past upends their settled lives.

1617335.title: Kids' Festival! All the Heroes of Justice Appear
1617335.overview: Kids' Festival! All the Heroes of Justice Appear was a televised celebration of tokusatsu heroes in 1976.

1623607.title: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy
1623607.overview: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy follows 50-year-old Val (Tisha Campbell), a devoted wife and stay at home mom, who is eager to reignite the spark in her marriage when her youngest child leaves for college. Grappling with empty-nest feelings, loneliness and growing emotional distance from her husband Ross (Russell Hornsby), Val begins to realize that her marriage and the woman she once was, may be slipping away. A spontaneous escape to New Orleans to support her pregnant daughter, Kayla (Zing Ashford), awakens long-buried dreams and passions and introduces her to Peter Mosley (Mekhi Phifer), a handsome and charismatic photographer who sees her in ways she has forgotten to see herself. Reawakening her artistic spirit and rediscovering her worth, Val must face a life-altering question: is it ever too late to choose yourself and the love you truly deserve?
1623607.trailerName: Mary J. Blige Presents Be Happy | Official Trailer (Lifetime 2026)

flatrate.name: Lifetime Movie Club Apple TV channel

1623927.title: Granny
1623927.overview: Granny is an upcoming film directed by Vijaya Kumara, starring Vadivukkarasi, Dhileepan, Singampuli, Gaja Raja, Ananthu Nag, and Aparna in prominent roles.

1625655.title: Mariinka
1625655.overview: In Eastern Ukraine, childhood neighbors find their lives violently derailed by a shifting frontline. Natasha, a promising boxing talent, becomes a military paramedic. Angela, who lost her parents at a young age, survives by moving goods to both sides of the front. Caught in a modern Greek tragedy, brothers Mark and Ruslan now fight on opposite sides – against each other. In the safety of his adoptive family in the United States, their youngest brother Daniil follows the war from afar.

1632247.title: My Father's Soul
1632247.overview: On a winter’s night, Romeo, a wide-eyed orphan, digs up his father’s corpse, drags it home, and wakes him up from the dead. Like a newborn, the father slowly rediscovers his senses, while Romeo does his best to take care of him. Though they no longer belong to the same world, both men share a fragility that cannot be concealed.

1632375.title: SOMEWHERE OVER THE RAINBOW
1632375.overview: A surreal odyssey follows a 16 year old throught music

1636855.title: Fish in a Barrel
1636855.overview: A group of friends devise a plan to avoid the workforce after graduating college. This plan however, could be detrimental to their lives.

1642295.title: Meu
1642295.overview: One morning, Raha’s beloved cat, Meu, suddenly goes missing. Unable to find Meu, Raha becomes deeply distressed. Amid the many complications and struggles within her family, Meu had been her only source of comfort. In the journey to find her beloved cat, Raha comes face to face with a new realization about life.

1643255.title: The Disconnection
1643255.overview: Luke is pressured by a pair of stereotypical bullies to get a new phone, so he enlists the help of his unpredictable, dumb friend Liam, but their mission quickly spirals into chaos when a pair of rich, phone-obsessed twins enter the classroom, turning a simple task into a ridiculous, absurd adventure.

1647159.title: The Crossing
1647159.overview: On a perilous journey north, a Guatemalan farmer risks everything to secure a future for his family, as past and present collide in a story of survival, memory, and sacrifice.

1653495.title: Ex Situ
1653495.overview: A paleontologist obsessed with making a historic discovery illegally returns to excavate a unique fossil, but her ambition drives her to sacrifice everything.

1660343.title: Ghostfluencer
1660343.overview: To create a new legendary love story that can be remembered, a 'northern ghost woman' from more than a century ago begins her mission by searching for her true love from her previous life.
1660343.trailerName: Curse of the City | OFFICIAL TRAILER

1661559.title: Homo Machina
1661559.overview: As a lonely man isolates himself, the line between the digital and physical world blurs.

1661815.title: Countenance
1661815.overview: Asha is a young man with the ability to feel and resonate other people's emotions through physical contact. Turned into a recluse by the burden of his abilities, he is constantly plagued with the predicament of whether he should strip people of their negative emotions but consequently bare the burden himself or does he turn a blind eye, and leave people to their suffering?

1663287.title: Paul and Greg and Amelia
1663287.overview: A novelist struggling with writer's block interviews his wealthy estranged college roommate and his wife, where an old secret threatens all of their safety.

1663415.title: Трудные папы
1663415.overview: Katya is smart, modest and diligent, but most importantly, she is very convenient for those around her, which they take advantage of. After the death of her overprotective mother, Katya inherits her mother's late lover Andrey Nikolaevich, who has nowhere else to live, along with the house. However, this is not our heroine's main problem. The secrets that her mother hid from Katya during her life, the mortgage debt, because of which she could lose her home, and the mysterious man to whom her mother has been sending large sums of money for many years - Katya will have to figure all this out, and for the first time in her life - on her own.

1664119.title: The Next Karate Kid
1664119.overview: Twelve-year-old Sasha is forced to leave Moscow for Pyatigorsk to live with his aunt while his doctor parents are on assignment in Africa. Local children, school bullying, and conflict with the leader, Marat, become part of his new life. When his parents disappear during a flood, the boy faces utter despair. Seeking strength, he discovers a passion-karate, where his strict sensei, Dmitriy, and his daughter, Masha, help him overcome his fears, develop his character, and find inner strength.

1665527.title: Hope
1665527.overview: After doom-scrolling on social media, a young poet named Salome Agbaroji is thrust into a fantastic journey through a magical animated realm, where she encounters a majestic Black Crowned Crane.

1667191.title: The Resurrection of Christ
1667191.overview: The story of Jesus Christ has been portrayed countless times throughout the history of cinema, from the chaste and embryonic staging of the silent film era to the frenetic dynamism of the digital age at the beginning of the 21st century. Death and rebirth are present in a perpetual cycle in which the sacred myth is transformed into the product of a spiritual franchise.

1668023.title: The Ultimate Linemarker
1668023.overview: We follow Borus, a road line marker who treats asphalt like a sacred canvas, as he passionately explains the emotional and deep importance of straight lines, proper spacing, and precision. His manager and a rival crew who see the job as “just paint” are brought into the world of Borus, who always has a new way of sharing his passion of the job. His world is thrown into chaos when a reckless young teammate commits the ultimate workplace sin: unauthorized road doodling. As Borus spirals over compromised line integrity, In the ultimate irony, he is “punished” with the assignment of his dreams — the very stretch of road he’s been dreaming about for years. For Borus, it’s not discipline. It’s destiny.

1672375.title: Anfa 8
1672375.overview: In the city of Soli, ruled by Anfa 8, where night is eternal, Horus hunts a renegade cult of solar worshippers who are desperately searching for the sun.

1679095.title: Untitled Caedmon Reveley Short
1679095.overview: After returning home from work, a man realizes that his TV is missing. Spiraling into a confused state, he finds himself asking everyone he knows where his TV could be. As the day comes to a close, will he ever find his missing property?

1684663.title: Anchors Aweigh
1684663.overview: When a well-meaning loser gets rejected by his much younger and more successful blonde girlfriend, he rents a small sailboat by the airport and spirals into a state of deep personal reflection.

1684791.title: Infinity Mirror
1684791.overview: During a tense encounter in a bar bathroom, Bash gets trapped in a time loop with his ex-best friend—and his only hope of escape is to confront what tore them apart.

1686519.title: Mr. Penguin: The Movie
1686519.overview: When unexplained events begin to occur, a hidden presence reveals itself. Silent, watchful, and growing closer—Mr. Penguin is no longer just a mystery.
1686519.trailerName: Mr. Penguin: The Movie | Announcement Trailer

1691127.title: Dinner
1691127.overview: Our short film captures the comedic chaos of a quintessential romantic dinner interrupted by a mischievous, scene-stealing rat. Through intricate character animation and expressive physical comedy, we explore the hilarious tension between high-stakes elegance and an uninvited, tiny antagonist, creating a delightful story about finding laughter in the midst of a perfect plan gone wrong.

1692151.title: Infrared

1775287.title: Tableaux
1775287.overview: Tableaux presents three new works by Ulrich Seidl for the Über das Leben, die Liebe und den Tod exhibition in EYE FilmMuseum in Amsterdam . Each is composed of footage originally shot for different films but never used. The material consists of so-called tableaux, a distinctive hallmark of Seidl’s visual language in which one or more of his protagonists are filmed looking directly into the camera in silence for a brief period. These images or scenes are unsettling not only because they break the ‘sacred’ fourth wall, but above all because Seidl makes the viewer complicit. The protagonists look directly into your eyes. It is as though the viewer, rather than the person on screen, is caught in the act of voyeurism. The effect is disconcerting, yet it also creates a more immediate sense of engagement with the characters.
